nodes.label: Simplified Static HTML Fixture Pattern
nodes.rationale: Amex CA fixtures use minimal hand-authored HTML with semantic sections (hero, rates, terms) rather than full live-site captures, enabling deterministic parser tests without network dependencies.

nodes.label: Scrapers propose, humans dispose
nodes.rationale: No scraped fact reaches users without passing through the review/publish workflow.

nodes.label: Stale Live Capture 404 Fixture Pattern
nodes.rationale: Several live-listing and live-detail fixtures snapshot issuer 404 pages instead of product content, indicating captured URLs went stale and tests must handle missing or relocated pages gracefully.

nodes.label: Never lose a bonus
nodes.rationale: Deadline and eligibility alerts are sacred notifications.

nodes.label: Show the math
nodes.rationale: Every reward number is explainable down to the rate × amount line.

nodes.label: Earning Hierarchy
nodes.rationale: Welcome bonus churning (~10-20X) dominates category optimization (~3-5X); product must never let users miss WBs.

nodes.label: Capture is king
nodes.rationale: Everything downstream depends on frictionless spend ingestion.

nodes.label: Churney
nodes.rationale: Command center for Canadian credit card optimizers combining spend capture, reward estimation, program intelligence, churn engine, and daily-wallet planning.

nodes.label: Never Call the Bank policy
nodes.rationale: Calling about ineligible bonuses triggers crackdowns and harms the hobby; Churney must never coach users to dispute ineligibility.

nodes.label: Confidence Tags ([OFFICIAL]/[COMMUNITY]/[VERIFY])
nodes.rationale: Rules gating engine decisions default to [VERIFY] and must be confirmed against issuer T&Cs before user-facing use.
